"""Own exact polyphase fixtures,not DFENet reproduction or denoising evidence."""
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import urllib.request
import numpy as np
from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save
from demosaic.prediction_archive import fingerprint

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');cache=repo/'.cache/research-20261107';cache.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
paper=cache/'arxiv-2503.15800v1.html'
if not paper.exists():
 with urllib.request.urlopen('https://arxiv.org/html/2503.15800v1',timeout=30) as response:raw=response.read()
 with paper.open('xb') as f:f.write(raw)
assert b'Frequency Enhancement for Image Demosaicking' in paper.read_bytes()
height,width=32,40;y,x=np.mgrid[:height,:width]
period8=np.asarray([1,2**-.5,0,-2**-.5,-1,-2**-.5,0,2**-.5])[x%8]
signals={
 'constant':np.full((height,width),.005),
 'affine':.005+1e-5*x+2e-5*y,
 'crossed-low-contrast':.005+2e-5*(np.cos(2*np.pi*(x/8+y/16))+np.sin(2*np.pi*(x/10-y/8))),
 'checkerboard':.005+2e-5*((-1.0)**(x+y)),
 'oblique-high-frequency':.005+2e-5*np.cos(2*np.pi*(3*x/8+y/8)),
 'chirp':.005+2e-5*np.sin((x*x+y*y)/20),
 'alias-low':.005+2e-5*period8,
 'alias-high':.005+2e-5*period8*((-1.0)**x),
}
rows=[];arrays={}
# Independent dense normalized DFT matrices do not call FFT.
dy=np.exp(-2j*np.pi*np.outer(np.arange(height),np.arange(height))/height)/np.sqrt(height)
dx=np.exp(-2j*np.pi*np.outer(np.arange(width),np.arange(width))/width)/np.sqrt(width)
ky,kx=np.mgrid[:height,:width];phases=[(0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1)]
for name,value in signals.items():
 packed=np.stack([value[py::2,px::2] for py,px in phases]);unpacked=np.empty_like(value)
 for p,(py,px) in zip(packed,phases,strict=True):unpacked[py::2,px::2]=p
 assert np.array_equal(value,unpacked)
 packed_fft=np.fft.fft2(packed,norm='ortho');native=np.fft.fft2(value,norm='ortho')
 reconstructed=sum(np.exp(-2j*np.pi*(ky*py/height+kx*px/width))*p[ky%(height//2),kx%(width//2)]/2 for p,(py,px) in zip(packed_fft,phases,strict=True))
 dense=dy@value@dx.T
 error=float(np.max(np.abs(reconstructed-native)));dense_error=float(np.max(np.abs(reconstructed-dense)))
 assert error<2e-15 and dense_error<2e-15
 assert abs(np.sum(value*value)-np.sum(packed*packed))<1e-15
 rows.append({'name':name,'native_shape':[height,width],'packed_shape':list(packed.shape),'pack_unpack_bitexact':True,
  'maximum_unfolded_vs_native_FFT_difference':error,'maximum_unfolded_vs_dense_DFT_difference':dense_error,
  'input':fingerprint(value),'packed':fingerprint(packed)})
 arrays[name]=value;arrays[name+'::packed']=packed;arrays[name+'::unfolded_fft']=reconstructed
first,second=arrays['alias-low::packed'],arrays['alias-high::packed']
assert np.array_equal(first[[0,2]],second[[0,2]])
assert not np.array_equal(first,second)
# All packed per-phase magnitudes match after DC removal, but cross-phase
# complex signs distinguish the native frequency. Magnitude-only evidence
# need not identify the correct native alias.
f1=np.fft.fft2(first-.005,norm='ortho');f2=np.fft.fft2(second-.005,norm='ortho')
assert np.max(np.abs(np.abs(f1)-np.abs(f2)))<2e-17
archive=cache/'packed-fourier-fixtures-v1.npz';assert not archive.exists();np.savez(archive,**arrays)
output=repo/'docs/results/packed-fourier-reading-20261107-v1.json';assert not output.exists()
save(output,{'status':'pass-eight-own-polyphase-and-independent-dense-DFT-fixtures','source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
 'paper':{'url':'https://arxiv.org/html/2503.15800v1','cached_html':ref(paper),'preprint_date':'2025-03-20',
  'journal_url':'https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0165168426002264','journal_issue_date':'2026-11',
  'sections_read':['3.1-3.3','4','5.1','5.4','5.5','6'],
  'paraphrase':'DFENet separately selects frequencies for spatial refinement and CFA-guided suppression,using staged RGB/intermediate spectral losses. Its tests use simulated Gaussian CFA noise and small line-pattern targets. Local patch inference reduces a reported size-distribution gap. The March2025 preprint precedes its November2026 journal issue.'},
 'own_arrays':ref(archive),'rows':rows,'alias_fixture':{'even_x_phases_bitexact':True,'complete_packed_tuple_distinct':True,
  'packed_phase_magnitude_max_difference':float(np.max(np.abs(np.abs(f1)-np.abs(f2)))),'native_frequencies_cycles_per_pixel':[.125,-.375]},
 'own_inference':'Packing is an invertible rearrangement,not averaging. A phase-aware sum of all four packed spectra reconstructs every native mosaic Fourier bin exactly up to FP64 roundoff. Per-plane spectra fold frequencies;discarding phase or averaging planes can lose native-alias distinctions. This does not recover missing RGB color samples or prove our existing learned features use the available phase information.',
 'limits':'These deterministic scalar-mosaic algebra fixtures are not paper reproduction,trained quality,RAW-noise covariance or a flat-safety result. No external code,weights or dataset adopted;V166 fixed. Eight small fixtures,no RNG,no neural/source/sensor-noise/RAW/dataz calls.',
 'new_neural_forwards':0,'new_sensor_sampler_calls':0,'new_training_data':0})
print('PASS8 exact pack/unpack fixtures;max FFT',max(r['maximum_unfolded_vs_native_FFT_difference'] for r in rows),'dense DFT',max(r['maximum_unfolded_vs_dense_DFT_difference'] for r in rows))

paper.paraphrase: DFENet separately selects frequencies for spatial refinement and CFA-guided suppression,using staged RGB/intermediate spectral losses. Its tests use simulated Gaussian CFA noise and small line-pattern targets. Local patch inference reduces a reported size-distribution gap. The March2025 preprint precedes its November2026 journal issue.

own_inference: Packing is an invertible rearrangement,not averaging. A phase-aware sum of all four packed spectra reconstructs every native mosaic Fourier bin exactly up to FP64 roundoff. Per-plane spectra fold frequencies;discarding phase or averaging planes can lose native-alias distinctions. This does not recover missing RGB color samples or prove our existing learned features use the available phase information.
limits: These deterministic scalar-mosaic algebra fixtures are not paper reproduction,trained quality,RAW-noise covariance or a flat-safety result. No external code,weights or dataset adopted;V166 fixed. Eight small fixtures,no RNG,no neural/source/sensor-noise/RAW/dataz calls.
